user_access_grants_scope_shape_check.name: user_access_grants_scope_shape_check
user_access_grants_scope_shape_check.value:
(
          "user_access_grants"."scope_type" = 'tenant'
          AND "user_access_grants"."organization_id" IS NULL
          AND "user_access_grants"."team_id" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "user_access_grants"."scope_type" = 'organization'
          AND "user_access_grants"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "user_access_grants"."team_id" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "user_access_grants"."scope_type" = 'team'
          AND "user_access_grants"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "user_access_grants"."team_id" IS NOT NULL
        )

user_access_grants_role_scope_check.name: user_access_grants_role_scope_check
user_access_grants_role_scope_check.value:
(
          "user_access_grants"."role" = 'client_admin'
          AND "user_access_grants"."scope_type" = 'tenant'
        )
        OR
        (
          "user_access_grants"."role" = 'director'
          AND "user_access_grants"."scope_type" = 'organization'
        )
        OR
        (
          "user_access_grants"."role" = 'manager'
          AND "user_access_grants"."scope_type" = 'team'
        )
        OR
        (
          "user_access_grants"."role" = 'prospector'
          AND "user_access_grants"."scope_type" = 'team'
        )
        OR
        (
          "user_access_grants"."role" = 'observer'
          AND "user_access_grants"."scope_type" IN (
            'tenant',
            'organization',
            'team'
          )
        )

establishments_coordinates_pair_check.name: establishments_coordinates_pair_check
establishments_coordinates_pair_check.value:
(
          "establishments"."latitude" IS NULL
          AND "establishments"."longitude" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "establishments"."latitude" IS NOT NULL
          AND "establishments"."longitude" IS NOT NULL
        )

establishment_contacts_identity_check.name: establishment_contacts_identity_check
establishment_contacts_identity_check.value:
nullif(btrim("establishment_contacts"."name"), '') IS NOT NULL
        OR nullif(btrim("establishment_contacts"."email"), '') IS NOT NULL
        OR nullif(btrim("establishment_contacts"."phone"), '') IS NOT NULL

campaigns_date_range_check.name: campaigns_date_range_check
campaigns_date_range_check.value:
"campaigns"."starts_at" IS NULL
        OR "campaigns"."ends_at" IS NULL
        OR "campaigns"."ends_at" >= "campaigns"."starts_at"
